left.raw_text: Previous surgical or catheter ablation for atrial fibrillation
Previous cardiac surgery (including CABG) within the past 6 months (180 days)
Valvular cardiac surgical/percutaneous procedure (i.e., ventriculotomy, atriotomy, and valve repair or replacement and presence of a prosthetic valve)
LA size > 50 mm (parasternal long axis view)
History of blood clotting or bleeding abnormalities

left.raw text: PCI/MI within the past 2 months (60 days)
Documented thromboembolic event (including TIA) within the past 12 months (365 days)
Uncontrolled heart failure or NYHA function class III or IV

OR.raw text: Severe mitral regurgitation (Regurgitant volume = 60 mL/beat, Regurgitant fraction = 50%, and/or Effective regurgitant orifice area = 0.40cm2)

left.raw text: Awaiting cardiac transplantation or other cardiac surgery within the next 12 months (365 days)
Acute illness or active systemic infection or sepsis

OR.raw text: AF secondary to electrolyte imbalance, thyroid disease, or reversible or non-cardiac cause.

Significant pulmonary disease, (e.g., restrictive pulmonary disease, constrictive or chronic obstructive pulmonary disease) or any other disease or malfunction of the lungs or respiratory system that produces chronic symptoms.

left.raw text: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD; active requiring significant intervention not including OTC medication)

OR.raw text: Significant congenital anomaly or medical problem that in the opinion of the investigator would preclude enrollment in this study.

left.raw text: Women who are pregnant (as evidenced by pregnancy test if pre-menopausal)

OR.raw text: Concurrent enrollment in an investigational study evaluating another device, biologic, or drug.

left.raw text: Presence of intracardiac thrombus, myxoma, tumor, interatrial baffle or patch or other abnormality that precludes vascular access, or manipulation of the catheter.
